description: Implementation of SocketTracker class managing socket lifecycle events, tracking socket states, and logging socket information within the starboard namespace.

classes.name: SocketTracker
classes.description: Manages socket lifecycle events, tracking socket states, and provides logging and status querying functionalities.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of SocketTracker.

methods.name: OnCreate
methods.description: Handles socket creation event, records socket info.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Handles socket destruction, removes socket from tracking.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Records socket connection event with remote address.

methods.name: OnBind
methods.description: Records socket bind event with local address.

methods.name: OnAccept
methods.description: Handles socket accept event, adds accepted socket to tracking.

methods.name: OnReceiveFrom
methods.description: Updates last activity and remote address on receive.

methods.name: OnSendTo
methods.description: Updates last activity and remote address on send.

methods.name: OnResolve
methods.description: Records hostname resolution for addresses.

methods.name: IsSocketTracked
methods.description: Checks if a socket is currently tracked.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves local address of a socket.

methods.name: OnListen
methods.description: Records listen event and updates socket state.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns current state of a socket.

methods.name: OnAddWaiter
methods.description: Associates a waiter with a socket.

methods.name: OnRemoveWaiter
methods.description: Removes associated waiter from a socket.

methods.name: LogTrackedSockets
methods.description: Logs information about all tracked sockets.

methods.name: ConvertToString_Locked
methods.description: Converts socket address or record to string for logging.

methods.name: ComputeIdleTimePerSocketForThreadId
methods.description: Computes idle times for sockets associated with a thread.

methods.name: ConvertToString_Locked
methods.description: Converts socket record details to string.

methods.name: ComputeTimeIdle
methods.description: Calculates idle time for a socket record.
